'''Tarelle sel-weave''' was a type of material often used in [[shirt]]s around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] owned a [[Color/Legends|blue]] Tarelle sel-weave shirt.
